title: [Process Doc Update]: README, project management processes summary, and links — OctoAcme Project Management README
head: add-octoacme-docs-readme
body:
Closes #2

Add docs/README.md that indexes OctoAcme project management process documents and provides a brief summary of initiation, planning, execution & tracking, release & deployment, and retrospective processes to improve discoverability for contributors and stakeholders.
